record.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina stages pandemic foreign-entry prohibitions, March–September 2020
record.scope: Foreign-entry restriction applied at land borders; aviation closures excluded as separate measures
record.crossings: Bosnian international land admission posts; individual first-refusal posts not named in retrieved report
record.movement: Initially foreign arrivals from Italy, Iran, South Korea and specified Chinese areas; additional origins from 15 March; later non-exempt foreign entrants generally
record.exceptions: Bosnian citizens; later documented resident, medical, worker, civil-protection/military, freight-crew, home-transit and special-permit categories; agricultural and business easing.
record.imposing_authority: Ministry of Security and Border Police of Bosnia and Herzegovina; subsequent Council of Ministers decisions
record.enforcement: Border Police told RSE the initial order took effect on 10 March and field offices were implementing it by 11 March. The director separately reported five refusals on 25 March after the broader phase. No independent eyewitness observation of the first refusal retrieved.
record.consequences: Police-confirmed denied admission; no causal estimate or assumption that all annual refusals were pandemic-related.
record.relationship: Separate imposing authority and movement category from neighbouring-country restrictions. Reciprocal policies must not be added as extra border-wide days.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no status inference at 21 October 2026
record.context: A targeted prohibition reportedly took effect on 10 March, expanded origins on 15 March, and broadened to non-exempt foreigners by 25 March. Agricultural, business and neighbouring-nationality exceptions expanded before September.
record.uncertainty: Initial origin-specific ban was recommended March 10 and confirmed implemented March 11; precise effective onset remains bounded to March 10–11. September 12 at 06:00 is conditional formal admission, not observed first passage. The March 24–25 to May 28 phase remains scoped to non-exempt neighbouring-country tourists.

historical.duration_note: Formal change of permission; operational reopening and continuous effective duration not established. No claim of a continuous nationwide operational closure.
